label: Bible Study
prompt: But seek ye first the _____ of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verse: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
note: 'Seek ye first' — the ordering of priorities that makes everything else 'added.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great _____.
verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
note: Three words to the sea — 'Peace, be still' — and the storm remembers who made it.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Go ye therefore, and _____ all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verse: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
note: Modern versions say 'make disciples,' but the KJV's Great Commission says 'teach all nations.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: The heart is _____ above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verse: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
note: Jeremiah's warning: the least trustworthy narrator you know lives in your own chest.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Be not deceived: evil _____ corrupt good manners.
verse: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
note: 'Evil communications corrupt good manners' — the KJV's rendering of 'bad company.'
